lines.en: I glide past the sea rocks.
My wingspan is three paces wide.
The sea wind holds me steady.
I fly level with the wave crests.

There's an updraft by the treeline.

lines.zh: 我在石岸和森林之间飞。
lines.en: I fly between the shore and the woods.

lines.zh: 我落在一块石头上休息。
lines.en: I settle on a stone to rest.

lines.zh: 尾巴在飞行中拉得很直。
lines.en: My tail streams straight behind me.
My wing membrane is very thin.
I climb back to canopy height.
I fly along the surf line toward the woods.
I make a wide loop and come back.
I cling to the cliff and rest.
My wings fold against my sides.

I preen my wing with my beak.

I don't fly when the wind's too strong.
There's still fish on my tongue.

This rock is mine to stand on.
My claws are thin and sharp.
Sea birds call from every side.

The taste of salt stays in my mouth.

I look down at you from above.
You're soaked right through.
My beak is sharper than you'd think.
You're in the way of my takeoff.
There's a veil of spray between us.

Your steps are making the rock ring.

lines.zh: 你看起来像会抓鸟的人。
lines.en: You look like someone who catches birds.
I've moved to the edge first.
One of my wings is a bit askew.
I came down and got back up.

Even something this light can hurt.
Something in my bones got scraped.

I can keep flying.
That one was genuinely unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我只吃自己抓到的东西。
lines.en: I only eat what I catch myself.
You're holding it up too high.
On the sea cliff, my beak opens.
I stare at it for a long while.
My teeth come in two lengths.
The wind has scattered its smell.
I don't quite trust your hands.
I dip my head and lift it again.

lines.zh: 你把我一边翅膀撞到了。
lines.en: You knocked one of my wings.
I nearly lost my footing.
That bump was almost nothing.
My bones are hollow and light.
That barely touched me.
I got pushed toward the cliff edge.
The salt rubbed off the stone.
Don't push any further forward.
We share one sea rock.
The left is yours; the right is mine.
Our nest sits in the rock cleft.
Flying together saves effort.
The tips of your wings are darker.
We circle the same stretch of sea.
Don't take my landing spot.

I snatch up a small fish.

You're moving around below me.

The wind is good in this direction.
I circle up above your head.

lines.zh: 你的动作在沙滩上很明显。
lines.en: Your movement stands out on the sand.
I drop low and skim past.

lines.zh: 你的帽子被风掀起来了。
lines.en: The wind lifted your hat.
I swing back around for another pass.
You have to look up to see me.
You have nowhere to hide.
I wait for you to leave a gap.
This pass I'm flying lower.

The sea wind carries me very steadily.

Just one more degree of angle.
My talons rake your shoulder.

My wings slap wind in your face.
You're knocked down onto the sand.
That blow wasn't heavy.
You blocked the second strike.
I missed and pulled up again.
My talons are very sharp.
Sand flies where my wings beat.

I wheel back around above you.
I'd call that one mine.

lines.zh: 海风一下灌满我的翅膀。
lines.en: The sea wind fills my wings at once.
These sea rocks are very slippery.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀晾了一会儿。
lines.en: I hold my wings open to dry.
The surf is right below my feet.
There's a treeline in the distance.
My first launch went a little crooked.
The sun makes the sea white.
There's sand on my beak.
This coast suits me well.

lines.zh: 我听见有人踩碎了贝壳。
lines.en: I hear someone crunching shells.
I turn to look that way.
I give a soft call.
The membrane of my wings tightens.

lines.zh: 热气把我的皮膜烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat has curled my wing membrane.
I dropped from a height.
The water swallowed me at once.
The blast sent me tumbling.
An arrow punched through my wing.

lines.zh: 那阵光让我的骨头打颤。
lines.en: That light set my bones shaking.
Hunger keeps me from flying high.
No sea below, and no wind.
